ThePreset Text NodefromComfyUI-Custom-Scriptswas broken by the recent ComfyUI update.

Temporary solution:launch your ComfyUI with the following arguments:

--front-end-version Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend@1.2.2

This pack is all about making AI art easy. It’s packed with beginner-friendly workflows for creating and enhancing images with Flux.1-dev, Stable Diffusion 1.5, and XL models using LoRAs, upscaling and AI prompt enhancer without installing and running LLMs locally.

Included:

  • Flux.1-D/fp8 Workflows: Three versions, including prompt enhancement and upscaling

  • SD1.5 & XL Workflows: Two version with prompt enhancement and upscaling

The Flux based workflows comes with negative prompt support (using Xlabs Sampler), Lora loader, and upscaling with Ultimate SD Upscale. I have included various help and descriptions for those who just getting started. Feel free to ignore and delete the notes in the workflows if you already know what to do.
